text: Healthy living is about more than just avoiding illness; it is about creating a routine that supports your whole body and mind. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, provides the fuel you need for energy and focus. Regular exercise, even a daily 30-minute walk, strengthens your heart and reduces stress. Equally important is sleep—aim for 7 to 9 hours each night to let your body recover. But don’t forget your mental health. Taking time to relax, talk to friends, or practice a hobby can work wonders. Finally, strive for a healthy work-life balance. Set boundaries between work and personal time, and make sure you have moments to recharge. Small, consistent choices lead to big improvements over time.
